template_data.headline_html: Four habits of small businesses that actually win.

items.title: Weekly Sources Sought search
items.desc: Saved SAM.gov searches in your NAICS, checked every week — not when you remember.

items.title: Recompete calendar
items.desc: Track contracts your target agencies already hold. 90 days out is when prep starts.

items.title: Industry day attendance
items.desc: Show up before the RFP drops, even before your Schedule is approved.

items.title: Agency contact list
items.desc: Two or three target agencies. Names and POCs, not just department names.
